name: Dithering — effect fixture
description: Proving fixture for the dithering Effect (ported to WGSL from @paper-design/shaders image-dithering, Apache-2.0). Runs the ordered dither over the pullquote-on-photo surface — the synthesized photographic substrate's tonal ramps and bokeh give the posterizer real gradients to quantize (Bayer 4×4, 3 steps, original colors), so the effect reads unmistakably: smooth falloff becomes woven cell bands while the quote's serif edges stay cell-crisp. Full-frame piece (backgroundFill); the effect's transparent-alpha contract (E4) is proven separately by the effect-chain tests. Fixture — exercises the pipeline, not held to the deliverable floors.

content.title: Every cell rounds its brightness against a fixed threshold — gradients become weave, edges keep their shape.
content.author: ORDERED DITHERING — BAYER 4×4
